title: System initialization
subtitle: Enter the initial system settings (first run only).
doneDescription: The system is already initialized. No further action is needed.
doneSettingsHint: To change settings, sign in and open System Settings.
usernameHint: Start with a letter; use letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens (6-20 characters).
usernamePattern: Username must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens (6-20 characters).
passwordHint: Use at least two of: numbers, uppercase letters, lowercase letters or special characters.
passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
passwordNeedsTwoTypes: Password must contain at least two of: numbers, uppercase letters, lowercase letters or special characters.
emailHint: Used for system notifications and password recovery.
phoneHint: Used to receive SMS verification codes.
